title: MDPack manifest (mdpack.json), specification 0.1.0-draft
description: Structural schema for the manifest of an MDPack package. This schema is a convenience for tooling and cannot express every requirement of the specification: checksum correctness, byte lengths, and the correspondence between declared assets and actual archive entries all require reading the container. Where this schema and the specification disagree, the specification governs.

version.description: Specification version the package was written against (section 4.5).

entrypoint.description: Path of the entry document. Fixed in this version (section 4.6).

title.description: Display name. Readers fall back to the file name without the extension.

createdAt.description: Creation time, RFC 3339 UTC with a Z suffix (section 4.8).

modifiedAt.description: Last save time, RFC 3339 UTC with a Z suffix (section 4.8).

generator.description: Application that last wrote the package. Diagnostics only.

markdownDialect.description: Declared Markdown dialect, used only as a rendering hint (section 11.1).

documentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes of document.md. Verified when present (section 7).

assetPath.description: Relative archive path under assets/. Rejects traversal, absolute paths, drive letters and backslashes (sections 4.7 and 8.2).

mediaType.description: Declared media type. Never trusted for rendering (section 8.5).

bytes.description: Uncompressed length in bytes; verified against the archive entry (section 4.7).

role.description: Descriptive usage hint. Unknown values are ignored, not rejected (section 4.9).

originalName.description: Source file name, when the stored name had to be altered (section 6.7).
